Backend 4/4 pytest: GET /api/v1/masters/currencies/public returns 25 ISO-4217 currencies (USD/EUR/KZT/INR/GBP/JPY all present, no _id leak); admin GET returns full list; POST USD duplicate -> 409; TST create + DELETE returns {ok:true, deactivated:true} and TST disappears from public list; GET /notices/PMC-NOT-2026-0001 returns 200 without redirect. Frontend verified end-to-end: (1) Anonymous visit to /notices/PMC-NOT-2026-0001 shows notice-topbar-signin + notice-topbar-register; dashboard/signout absent; no redirect to /login. (2) After admin login, same URL shows notice-topbar-dashboard chip (href /admin, label 'Dashboard') + notice-topbar-signout; signin/register absent. (5) Submit without category shows toast 'Category is required · pick from the master list' — no POST made. (6) Submit with category but no file shows toast 'Primary document (Tender Notice / RFQ / RFP) is required · upload a PDF or DOCX' — no POST made. (7) Happy path (title/desc/category/USD/deadline + .pdf) → POST /api/v1/notices 200 returning PMC-NOT-2026-0035; toast 'Draft saved · PMC-NOT-2026-0035'. Primary doc upload returned 400 only because my test fixture was 23 bytes (<min size) — backend validation is working as designed; this is NOT a bug. (8) After file picked, notice-primary-view, notice-primary-modify, notice-primary-print, notice-primary-delete all become present (verified).
critical_code_review_comments: currencies.py seed_defaults is correctly idempotent (count-based short-circuit + per-code find_one guard) — safe for repeated cold starts.

DELETE /masters/currencies/{id} is a SOFT deactivate (sets is_active=false). Good — avoids orphaning historical notices that reference the code. But there is no POST /currencies/{id}/reactivate — admin can only reactivate via PATCH with is_active=true. Consider explicit reactivate endpoint for consistency with other master toggles.
CurrencyIn allows symbol: Optional[str] with no max_length — a huge symbol could bloat UI. Add max_length ~ 8.
list_currencies admin endpoint accepts role 'reviewer','support','committee_member' but POST/PATCH/DELETE require 'admin' only — reasonable, but ensure docs reflect this.

NoticeDetailE auth-aware chrome correctly honors _skipAuthRedirect on probe /me calls — observed 401s in console for /admin/me and /vendor/me when anonymous, but UI did not redirect. Working as designed.

Side-rail highlighting after notice create jumps to 'Tender builder' link and the right panel shows tender-template picker. The notice IS saved as draft (toast confirms) but UX hint: after Create success, consider either closing the form and refreshing the notices list in-place, or snapping to the newly-created row. Current flow is slightly confusing — the user sees the Tender builder panel and might think the save failed.
